summary: Verified drag-and-drop visual feedback fix in ProposalEditor. Dragged 'Jugo Natural' from Bebidas onto Coffee Break header: emerald ring appears on target section (data-drop-target=true), PUT /api/proposals/{id}/items/{id} fires with section_title='Coffee Break' returning 200, and item persists in Coffee Break after reload. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: ProposalEditor.js is 4965 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into subcomponents (SectionCard, ItemRow, SortableWrappers, Summary, etc.) for maintainability.
isDropTarget logic correctly ignores same-section case (active.id !== id).
data-drop-target attribute added for testability — good practice.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing event_54895d68fe81 / proposal prop_34050f182519
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProposalEditor is at /events/{eventId} then click tab-order. Sections have data-testid section-dropzone-sectionhdr::{itype}::{title}. Item drag handles have aria-label='drag-handle'. dnd-kit PointerSensor requires page.mouse.down then small-delta move then steps>1 moves. Verified emerald hover feedback + PUT persistence end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Bug: dragging items over section headers had no visual feedback. Fix added isOver+active extraction from useSortable in SortableSectionWrapper, exposed as isDropTarget render prop arg. Wrapper applies ring-emerald-400 when true; consumer applies border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50/40 (card) and bg-emerald-100/70 (header). Works correctly.
